subject: Displaying in-table graphics in DataTables rendered in a shiny app

messages.author: d763070a68ca6a43
messages.subject: Displaying in-table graphics in DataTables rendered in a shiny app
parts:
Actual question

Is it possible to implement "in-table" or "in-line" graphics in a shiny UI?

A couple of days ago I watched this [video](https://player.oreilly.com/videos/9781771373845) about what you can do with R on Azure and it sparked my inspiration.

Besides the drag-and-drop-based Modelling UI, I really liked the fact theat they display descriptive stats graphics for each variable right in the table/matrix (see screenshot 1 and Minute 1:30 in the video)

Other than extending [DT](https://rstudio.github.io/DT/) in some way, I thought an easier start might be to put "in-line" (or aligned, in general) with other UI parts that directly related to certain variables of my dataset For example, I could put it next to my "filtering widgets" in a little shiny app I'm currently building (see screenshot 2 below)

But since I got to "web dev" via R and shiny, I wouldn't exactly know how to write the Javascript code to get this working.

Add-on question

Where would I start to create a drag-and-drop-enabled "canvas UI" part with shiny in order to being able to implement a modelling flow like they do in Azure ML Studio?

I've looked a bit at some basic options in [HTML5](http://www.w3schools.com/html/html5_draganddrop.asp) and [GoJS](http://gojs.net) but since I'm not a web dev/Javascript expert I don't really know how this could potentially be wired to shiny's existing functionality.
